visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A hand in a purple sleeve opens a light wood-textured door. Behind the door, a young woman with long dark hair is sitting on a white tiled floor wearing a light blue long-sleeved shirt and dark shorts. She looks up toward the camera with a wide-eyed, pleading facial expression and begins to reach out. (2) The woman grasps the grey trousers of the person filming with both hands, looking up with a pouting mouth and shifting her body weight on the floor. The background shows a minimalist indoor hallway with white walls and a small yellow pet bowl on the floor. (3) The camera moves downward as the person tries to pull away, but the woman clings tightly to their leg, maintaining her upward gaze. She smiles and makes exaggerated whiny facial expressions while holding the leg firmly. (4) The camera pans to the left to briefly show the interior of a bathroom with a white toilet and then pans back to the woman who is still sitting on the floor, now looking directly into the lens with a focused and determined smile.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The sound of a door hinge creaking open is followed immediately by a sharp female gasp. A high-pitched female voice speaks in a whiny, exaggerated tone, using Mandarin, expressing a desire for attention. (2) Shuffling sounds of clothing and soft footfalls indicate movement. A male voice responds in a lower, conversational pitch with an amused and slightly exasperated tone, questioning the sudden behavior. (3) The female voice continues with rising intonation, exhibiting a playful and demanding quality, complaining about a lack of hugging. The male voice laughs softly while talking, creating a comedic dialogue interplay. (4) The audio concludes with a series of quick, whiny vocal bursts from the female and a rhythmic shuffling of pants as the person tries to walk away, ending with a final whiny plea.
